At L_6 their words are 4261735 and 4612735, respectively, with different 321 counts. The correct pair is (2,1) with (3,2); unrestricted iteration over all cells is not repetition-free. The complete repaired RESULT.md derives the table from the prefix rank formula, proves the deletion-run criterion, and lists one representative per class. Its four duplicate pairs are disjoint and none deletes a triangular cell; the length-four base has two triple classes and two singleton classes. The checked 4-chordal bound gives the odd lower bound by integrality, while a degree-two insertion into the even ladder preserves two-connectivity and attains it. Anchored greedy ears have increments (1, at least 2) or (2, 3); equality allows no singleton step after a triangle and exactly one after a square. Hence a final singleton step comes from the unique even ladder, while a final two-vertex step is the forced operation F on a smaller odd minimizer. Both exceptional commutations were verified by explicit word identities, and F(321)=42513 handles the first triangle start. The exact cell and neighbor counts then yield 3m−2 distinct minimizers, of which m have one triangle.
